top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks credited to Katori and Ye is a single bounded invention: the magic-wavelength condition cancels the lattice light shift, Lamb-Dicke confinement removes Doppler and recoil effects, and many neutral atoms are interrogated on an ultranarrow transition. Uncertainties near 1e-18 are demonstrated and reproduced with Sr, Yb and Hg in several laboratories, and the two-name credit avoids arbitrary exclusions. The novelty margin over the 2005 and 2012 prizes and the attribution history are real reservations, but the ensemble-versus-single-ion distinction answers the first and a citation limited to invention and realisation answers the second, so this is clearly preferable to no award.
